item.title: Monalisa Cult Garden
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Shizuku Gumi
  • 発売日: 2009-08-15
  • スコア: なし (3 人評価)
  • 日本語名: モナリザカルトガーデン
  • 英語名: Monalisa Cult Garden

あらすじ

The founder and leader of the Design club has a habit of making me confused with erotic things and enjoy watching it.

On the other hand, Miss Saginomiya seems to have a bug for the cosplay while taking advantage of her nice body, and that causes us troubles…

Sometimes I feel ill at ease, but in the end, I kind of like this situation…
